title.narrative: UN Joint Programme on Social Protection in Zambia

description.narrative: The Government of the Republic of Zambia - United Nations Joint Programme on Social Protection Phase II (UNJPSP-II) with the lifespan 2019 to 2024 is a social protection systems and integration strengthening programme in support of the implementation of the Government’s National Social Protection Policy. The programme is led by the Ministry of Community Development and Social Services who coordinates the other participating government entities including the Office of the Vice President, Ministry of Finance and National Planning, Ministry of Labour and Social Security, Ministry of Health, National Food and Nutrition Commission, Disaster Management and Mitigation Unit (DMMU) and the Zambia Agency for People with Disabilities (ZAPD).

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
